units.source_text: 这期间源氏公子与明石姬夜夜欢聚。

en.t: During this time, Prince Genji and the Akashi lady spent joyful nights together.

units.source_text: 从六月起，明石姬怀了孕，身体常感不适。

en.t: From June onward, the Akashi lady became pregnant and often felt unwell.

units.source_text: 源氏公子到了即将与明石姬分别的时候，对她的爱情竟比以前更加深厚了。

en.t: As the time drew near for Prince Genji to part from the Akashi lady, his love for her grew even deeper than before.

units.source_text: 我是命里注定必须受苦的。”

en.t: I must be fated to suffer."
At that thought, his heart became tangled in confusion.

units.source_text: 明石姬呢，不消说异常悲伤。

en.t: As for the Akashi lady, needless to say, she was deeply sorrowful.

units.source_text: 源氏公子前年曾从京都身登意外可悲之旅途，当时但念将来终可返京，全赖如此，方得自慰。

en.t: The year before, Prince Genji had unexpectedly set out from Kyoto on a sorrowful journey, and at that time he could comfort himself only by thinking that one day he would surely return to the capital.

units.source_text: 那么此次启程返京，应该欢欣鼓舞，可是一想起何年方得重游此地，便不胜感慨。

en.t: So this departure for Kyoto ought to have filled him with joy, yet when he wondered when he might ever visit this place again, he was overcome with emotion.
